To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the visual range with an image intensifier can be described by a simple formula which is based on the target size and contrast and on the meteorological visual distance, and that this formula can be used for the prediction of the visual range for any value of vertical illuminance.

the target acquisition distance with an image intensifier can be calculated with a high degree of accuracy by using PHIND, which is based on the physical target contrast and on a characteristic target size, and that the target acquisition range can be increased by a factor of about two by using the image intensifier in combination with an optical telescope.

the recognition distance of an image intensifier is a function of the physical target characteristics (size, contrast and background clutter) and the meteorological conditions (vertical illuminance) and that the target characteristics can be described by a single parameter, the characteristic size, that is related to the target area and background clutter.
